2. Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. The present application has been filed on behalf of the Applicants under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing the charge sheet dated 04.05.2021, the summoning order dated 19.05.2021, and the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial No. 238 of 2021,
titled as, "State vs. Lakshman", relating to offences punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of the IPC and under Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, pending before the Court of the learned F.T.C./Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POSCO), Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
4. Along with the C-528 application, a Compounding Application (I.A. No. 1 of 2025) has also been filed.
5. Learned counsel for the Applicant and learned counsel for Respondent No. 2 submit that the parties have entered into terms of compromise.
The learned State Counsel seeks time to file objection(s) to the Compounding Application.
Heard on the Interim Relief Application (I.A. No. 02 of 2025).

10. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and after hearing learned counsel for the parties, it is hereby directed that, till the next date of listing, the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial No. 238 of 2021, titled as, "State vs. Lakshman", relating to offences punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of the IPC and under Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, pending before the Court of the learned F.T.C./Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POSCO), Rudrapur, District Udham C528/1076/2025 on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37219322/
1 Singh Nagar, shall remain stayed qua the present Applicant only.
11. Interim Relief Application stands disposed of accordingly.
